[{"insert":"Suitcase Walking Lunge

Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, like you're carrying two suitcases, and lunge forward. Keeping the load down at your sides instead of racked on your shoulders lets you handle more weight while your grip and upper back work to keep you tall. Take a controlled step, drop the back knee, and drive through the front heel. Brace your core and keep your chest up so the weight doesn't pull you into a slouch.
"}]
